def factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    ema_ret = daily_ret.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    signal = ema_ret * vol_ratio
    signal = signal.ffill().fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol"]
description: Crossover: primary mechanism from parent factor_vol_adjusted_ema_momentum (EMA momentum trend multiplied by volume intensity). Borrows the volume regime classification tool (classify_volume_regime) from parent factor_cross_herding_volsurge, replacing the simple EMA volume ratio with a more robust abnormal volume signal. This keeps the core directional persistence signal while improving the volume confirmation module.
